{{Top|leg}}
'''Gesl''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]] protected by the seagoing [[Imperial Irmenu Navy]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|91|Imperial Irmenu Navy}}</ref><ref name="ZotR">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref> [[Walon Vau]]'s [[Walon Vau's father|father]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the Imperial Irmenu Navy, was the [[Count of Gesl]].<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gesl was first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', which was written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TC" /> It was later incorrectly described as a planet in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
